title: Token Footprint Consolidator — runtime-driven microbatch shaping and pad amortization
creator: Javier Martinez
description: Problem: We observe a high pad tax on production traffic for short-to-medium prompts (~8–96 tokens) when coalescing prefills with incoming decode requests. This increases cost-per-response and reduces available throughput for P99-bound customers. Goal: Introduce a runtime component that consolidates token footprints across live requests, creates dynamic microbatch buckets based on runtime signals, and amortizes padding via selective consolidation and pad eviction heuristics. Deliver a conservative rollout that reduces average padding tokens by >=30% and improves overall tokens/sec by >=12% on c6 GPUs without increasing 99th-percentile latency beyond 5%.
acceptance_criteria: Avg padding tokens per request reduced by >=30% on representative traffic mix
End-to-end token throughput (tokens/sec) improves by >=12% on c6-family nodes
P99 latency delta <= +5% compared to baseline for production 99th-percentile SLAs
No regressions on KV cache hit-rate or decode correctness across regression suite
Feature gated behind runtime flag and can be disabled without full rollout
implementation_notes: Introduce a Token Footprint Consolidator (TFC) in the request router responsible for building ephemeral microbatch cohorts using runtime signals: sequence length histogram, prefill/streaming intent, and kernel affinity hints.
Cohort membership is scored using a lightweight cost model: padded_tokens_estimate + estimated kernel-switch penalty. Use kernel hinting metadata from model catalog when available.
When bundling, prefer 'prefill-first' packing for groups where prefill fraction > 60% to reduce repeated KV-cache loads and enable shared attention tiling.
Pad amortization strategy: allow small logical concatenation of compatible sequences up to a configurable token budget (default 256 tokens) when the decode latency SLO for the cohort remains met.

Pad eviction: if a cohort contains long-running streams that cause tail latency risk, proactively evict decode requests with low decode priority into a fast-path single-request kernel to avoid stalling the cohort.

Kernel selection: surface kernel affinity hints to the scheduler for each cohort; prefer fused attention kernels for cohorts with homogeneous seqlen and switch to multi-kernel staging when heterogeneity crosses threshold.
Telemetry: emit cohort-level metrics (cohort_size, avg_req_seqlen, padded_tokens, kernel_chosen, prefill_fraction, cohort_latency_p50/p95/p99) and log sample decisions to S3 for offline analysis.
Rollout: behind runtime feature flag; start with 5% shadow traffic, then 5% live ramp, 25%, 50%, 100% after 2-week observation windows and performance gate checks.
tradeoffs_and_risks: Concatenation and pad amortization can introduce hard-to-detect correctness issues if prompt separators or special tokens are mishandled — mitigated by strict separation markers and regression tests.
Kernel-switch penalties: aggressive grouping may increase kernel swaps per step; mitigate via conservative kernel affinity thresholds and monitoring.
KV cache consistency: prefills shared across requests require careful versioning and eviction semantics to avoid stale context; plan adds cache-scoped cohort IDs and TTLs.
Operational complexity: more routing logic increases attack surface for bugs — initial implementation will be isolated in router binary with kill-switch and detailed decision logs.
test_plan: Unit tests for scoring function and cohort builder with synthetic length distributions
End-to-end perf harness against QPS-simulated traffic representative of PLG and enterprise mix
A/B test comparing disabled vs enabled across three regions for 48 hours with telemetry validations
Regression suites covering tokenization edge cases, special tokens, and function-calling sequences
Chaos test: simulate delayed KV cache reads and ensure eviction fallback keeps tail latency within SLO
monitors_and_dashboards: Runtime -> TokenConsolidator cohort dashboard (new): cohort_size, padded_tokens_ratio, tokens_per_second, kernel_switch_rate
Alert: cohort_p99_latency > baseline_p99 * 1.05 for 5m -> Page on-call
Log sink: decision traces stored in s3://redwood-prod/tfc/traces/ for sampling and offline analysis
